lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, with blob diameter increasing and spatial frequency decreasing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the primary centroid blobs to form a coarse, grid-like geometric arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of discrete, high-luminance blobs is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, approximately 6-10 distinct nodes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-luminance, triangular-shaped object or anomaly is attached near the posterior insertion of the left pectoral fin; visible irregularity/indentation on the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of micro-luminance blobs clustered on the anterior rostrum and the leading edge of the left pectoral fin.
